# Gleeful

> Gleeful is an early test of a talking teacher for children in grades 1 to 12. The teacher speaks with the child and takes them into interactive 3D worlds (the first sample world is a trip to Mars). It is aimed at families worldwide.

## Status (honest)
- Early test version. Not yet open to the public. There is no sign-up yet.
- In the public test build, lessons are scripted, not live AI. A Claude-based AI teacher is in private testing.
- The 3D characters are placeholders.

## Who it is for
- Children in grades 1 to 12, always under a parent's account. Children never have their own accounts.
- Parents who want honest progress: the parent view separates help during a lesson from doing it alone in a later session.

## Planned pricing (not yet charging)
- Solo: US$29/month. Family: US$79/month. One price worldwide.
- A 7-day free trial is planned. No free tier.

## Privacy stance
- Least data: a child's nickname, grade, language and teacher choice. No surname, birth date, school, photos or location.
- We do not record or store audio. In the test build, speech-to-text is done by the child's browser (which may send audio to its vendor, e.g. Google for Chrome).
- Verifiable parental consent (COPPA, GDPR-K, Philippine Data Privacy Act) is required before real children use it, and is not built yet.

## Pages
- [Home](/): the start screen of the test build.

## Not for crawlers
- /parent, /tester and /api are private and must not be indexed or fetched.
